rv.t: 1. 컨트롤러 없으면 플레이 불가능함. 2. 모토크로스에 관심이 없으면 접근이 상당히 어려움. 3. 시뮬레이션을 표방하는 게임이다보니 오프로드 바이크에 대한 기본적인 이해도가 있어야 '그나마' 쉬워짐.
I would rather eat cow manure covered rocks, then play this game again, it ruined my marriage, made me lose the kids, and now my grandma has testicular cancer. Would recommend, 10/10.

The first 5-6 hours of gameplay will make you want to kill yourself. The physics engine is really hard to get a grasp on so the best advice i have for beginners is to just get hours on the game and find the right setup for you.
